big: When the government builds roads, rail and defence assets, factories receive orders and workers get paid. That is the capex cycle. The next leg analysts watch is private companies investing again.

lines: What are PLI and Gati Shakti?

PLI schemes reward extra manufacturing in electronics, autos, pharma and more. PM Gati Shakti plans infrastructure across ministries together. Government capex has led the cycle, and a private capex revival is the next step to watch.
